title: CFO-type executive, round 2: pinstripe suit
question: Which of these should the CFO-type executive look like, or what should change?

media.caption: The starting point: cfo-1 c4-s4, where you wrote "yeah but maype pinstripe suit, the color is too festive". Recipe art/candidates/portraits/cfo-1/recipes/c4.json, seed 4.

Pictures: c4-s4, then all 8 new renders in order, framed at the game's portrait scale. The one change is the suit colour, from bottle green to a pinstripe: p1 charcoal, p2 dark navy. Cut (three-piece, waistcoat, open collar, no tie), hair, face, age, smirk and seeds 1 to 4 are as c4; seed 4 is c4-s4's. Every render is a new generation, nothing pasted. No broken anatomy, so none were screened out. The charcoal comes out close to black on seeds 1 and 2.

The male cast's game portraits (Kenji, Mori, the guard, Hamada now), your Hamada pick h2-s1, c4-s4, then seed 4 of p1 and p2, at the size the game shows them on a 1080p desktop. Mori wears plain dark grey with a tie and Hamada plain navy with a tie; the pinstripe, waistcoat and open collar are what set this man apart.
